findings: NO OPEN LOOP — sentence 2 promises something ("Here's what it can do.") and nothing later returns to it. The approved script plants one in sentence two ("only matters when you have no signal") and returns to it with "Back to that signal." (framework S2, S10, S18)
CADENCE: only 1 sentence reaches 18 words (longest 18). The playbook asks for 'occasionally one long spec sentence' — with everything short, nothing reads as short. Nothing to push against.
SECOND PERSON: the first 'you' arrives 55% of the way in. Until then the viewer is watching something happen to other people. Move one 'you' into the opening.
HOUSE TIC: "here's what it" — already used in 1 other script(s) (claude-memory-everywhere). Say it a different way; a phrase the channel reuses stops being a hook and becomes a verbal habit.
HUMANIZER: recorded for this draft. The checks above are the measurable half; the `humanizer` pass is the half that decides whether it sounds like a person.
